failure_modes.description: The agent spends the entire episode budget on low-level exploration and trial-and-error inspection commands without transitioning to implementation and verification, leading to task timeout before completion.
failure_modes.needed_instead: The scaffold or agent prompt should guide early transition from exploration to implementation and enforce a structured milestone checklist.

capability_gaps.description: The agent was unable to complete the complex programming task of parsing a binary file format and generating the required output format within the maximum turn limit.

success_habits.description: Systematically inspecting version control logs and branch histories to locate lost state or target references before performing integration.
success_habits.risk_if_removed: Without checking history or reflogs to locate missing references, the agent would fail to identify the correct target state for recovery tasks.
